query: What features can be extracted from a company's business description to predict its regional cluster?

per_column.name: industry_vertical
per_column.rationale: Industry vertical extracted from the business description is external to the regional cluster and plausibly correlates with it (e.g., semiconductors/enterprise software concentrate in Silicon Valley), giving genuine predictive signal.

per_column.name: tech_stack_focus
per_column.rationale: Technology focus (AI/ML, biotech, hardware, cloud) is a description-derived attribute distinct from geography, and different tech specialties cluster regionally, so it carries predictive signal for the region.

per_column.name: stage_signals
per_column.rationale: Company maturity/funding stage is not a component of regional_cluster and can correlate with geography (VC-heavy early-stage ecosystems vs. established hubs), so it is a legitimate predictor.

per_column.name: market_reach
per_column.rationale: Market orientation (B2B, global, consumer, local) is external to the region label yet varies across regional ecosystems, providing plausible predictive leverage; note the 'local_silicon_valley' value hints at mild geographic contamination but is largely regional-signal rather than a restatement.

per_column.name: service_model
per_column.rationale: Business/service model (SaaS, hardware, consulting, VC) is a description-derived variable distinct from geography and can differ by regional cluster, so it plausibly carries predictive signal.

judge.rationale: All five columns are legitimate description-derived features that lie outside the regional_cluster focus and are not deterministic functions of it or leakage. Each plausibly correlates with region, and as a set they form a coherent, non-mechanical feature space (industry, technology, stage, market reach, service model). Predictive leverage is moderate rather than high: these attributes correlate imperfectly with region, some values are highly imbalanced/degenerate, and one value ('local_silicon_valley') edges toward geographic self-reference, capping the genuine incremental signal.
